The assist level has not been read yet. Please wait a moment and tap again.
Clock read-back implausible. The clock may have been set; please check again.
Only with no button held: a clock jump of more than 20\u00A0seconds while Bell or Boost is held makes the bike treat the button as stuck.
Test it at a standstill: with “on”, the level can change by accident as the bike starts rolling.
Only at a standstill and while the bike is not rolling; this cuts motor assist.
Not confirmed. The value was written, but the read-back does not confirm it; the stored value is unchanged.
The lamp channels cannot be read; nothing was changed.
The lamps were written back, but the read-back differs. A real state change (mode, lock, restart) brings them back.

Factory value 200
Stops a running alarm without the backup code. It also clears the soft-lock; if the bike was locked, YABA then offers “Lock again”.
Lock again
The alarm stop cleared the soft-lock. Without the Kick Lock engaged, the bike reads as unlocked.
Alarm off ends every stage and lifts the software lock. Lock the bike again afterwards if needed.
Motion watch. The bike reacts only to a shake and escalates after several knocks.
About 30\u00A0seconds of siren, then tracking mode. The 2G modem then reports about every 30\u00A0minutes instead of every 2\u00A0hours and uses battery power.
Straight into tracking mode with the soft-lock set, no siren.
YABA first downloads the bike’s log and saves it on the phone; then the diagnosis runs and the bike goes to standby. The report pushes the oldest log lines out, so it is saved beforehand.
